# Elevares Studio

> Calgary, Alberta real estate media and construction documentation studio specializing in pre-drywall 360° construction scans, iGUIDE digital twins, certified RMS measurements, 2D/3D floor plans, virtual staging, and real estate photography with a 24-hour turnaround.

## Company Overview
- **Business Name**: Elevares Studio (Elevare Studio)
- **Location**: 206 Elgin View SE, Calgary, AB T2Z 4N3, Canada
- **Service Area**: Calgary, Olds, Airdrie, Cochrane, Okotoks, Chestermere, and surrounding Southern/Central Alberta
- **Phone**: +1 (825) 883-1177
- **Email**: info@elevares.ca
- **Website**: https://www.elevares.ca/
- **Turnaround**: 24-hour standard delivery for pre-drywall scans, floor plans, and RMS measurements

## Core Builder & Real Estate Benefits
- **Pre-Drywall Warranty & Rough-In Protection**: Complete 360° visual documentation of exposed framing, electrical runs, plumbing rough-ins, and HVAC layouts captured before drywall installation to prevent destructive troubleshooting and simplify warranty claims.
- **Homeowner "X-Ray" Handover Blueprint**: Interactive iGUIDE digital twin handed over at possession so homeowners, project managers, and trades can see exact behind-the-wall stud locations, wiring, and plumbing runs for future renovations.
- **Certified RMS Measurements**: Accurate Alberta Residential Measurement Standard (RMS) exterior/interior measurements prepared for Calgary Realtors, builders, and MLS® compliance.
- **2D & Detailed Floor Plans**: Dimensioned floor plans with room measurements, fixtures, and offline-ready exports for marketing, permitting, and buyer packages.
- **Real Estate Photography & Virtual Staging**: Architectural and listing visuals designed to help custom builders, multi-family developers, and Calgary Realtors market properties with confidence.
